description: (K)₂NaSbBr₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight K clusters inside a NaSbBr₆ framework. In each K cluster, K is bonded in a distorted cuboctahedral geometry to  atoms. In the NaSbBr₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SbBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Br bond lengths are 2.90 Å. Sb is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form SbBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sb-Br bond lengths are 2.80 Å. Br is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Sb atom.
